Mentalismus

Terénní čtení inspirované knihou Kybalion (Three Initiates, 1908).

For this exercise, explore how attention changes your experience of a place. A camera sees a wall; memory may see home, exclusion, or possibility.

Tvůrčí cvičení

Describe the same street once as a stranger, then as someone returning home.
